svg.text: Route: /admin/inventory · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin and Staff (admin site, signed in)
• Unit-counted products have Adjust (13b). A recipe dish has no count of its own: it shows the servings its raw materials can make and links to Raw materials (14).
• Recent adjustments can be filtered by product and refresh live when anyone changes stock. With none yet: “No manual stock adjustments recorded yet.”
